A full fresh second application recovers a real injected postcommit mirror exception as applied.

criteria.evidence: Two real extensions retain three immutable exact snapshots and distinct independent registrations. Seven selected fresh Horn checks include initial registration and fresh proposal/registration pairs for both competitors and the second extension; mapped contexts are freshly checked individually.
